provenance.why: investment_risk v6 was DEPLOYED WITH NO ACCURACY NUMBER OF ANY KIND. This is the first one. It closes the ADR-021 gap for this filter, and completes the fleet: before today only 3 of 6 deployed filters had ever been measured, so llm-distillery#102's 'uplifting is the specificity outlier' was a claim over half the population.
provenance.data: datasets/training/investment_risk_v6/test.jsonl (held-out oracle test split; gitignored, lives on b650 and gpu-server)
provenance.calibration: the DEPLOYED filters/investment_risk/v6/calibration.json -- NOT a fresh fit, so these describe what production computes
provenance.box: b650, CPU, ~/llm-distillery/venv-prodparity (py 3.11.15, torch 2.11.0+cu130, transformers 5.0.0, peft 0.18.1). NOT the serving box -- but that configuration was measured BIT-IDENTICAL to gpu-server's serving venv on 2026-08-10 (660/660 rows, 0 verdict flips at every threshold 4.0-5.0, docs/evidence/2026-08-10-b650-gpu-production-stack-parity.md), so these are production's numbers for the CPU path.
caveats: MEASURED ON CPU; PRODUCTION SERVES ON GPU. CPU-vs-CUDA on the student is worth 1 verdict flip at a 4.0 op-point and 3 at 4.5 on uplifting v7 (max |delta| 0.1956). That term is UNQUANTIFIED for this filter. See llm-distillery#104.

Adapter weights were md5-verified against production's own copy before scoring (gpu-server llm-distillery for belonging/cultural_discovery; NexusMind's filters/ tree for investment_risk, whose llm-distillery copy on gpu-server lives under the HYPHENATED name 'investment-risk').

DO NOT RANK FILTERS ON `mae` (ADR-023). Each split has its own positive rate -- uplifting v7 32.7%, investment_risk v6 15.6%, solutions v6 16.2%, nature_recovery v4 15.3%, cultural_discovery v5 8.8%, belonging v1 11.5% -- and a more enriched split carries mechanically larger per-article error for identical quality. Only recall and specificity are conditional on the true class and comparable across filters.
provenance.op_point_change: 4.0 -> 4.25 (llm-distillery#102 method, ADR-023). The 4.0 numbers, measured 2026-08-10, were recall 0.7609, specificity 0.9550, FPR 4.50% (40 FP, 39 FN).
provenance.on_lens_definition: oracle gatekeepered weighted average >= 4.0, PINNED while the student's bar moved.
provenance.caveat_recorded_at_the_time: The ADR-023 case is WEAKER here than for uplifting v7 and this was known before shipping. This filter's false positives are NEAR-MISSES -- oracle median 3.05, max 3.90 -- and are mostly geopolitical/macro risk stories (Dutch budget analysis, Russian drone strikes on ports, FERC pipeline tariffs, supply-chain attacks) that the model rates above the oracle. A reader on an investment-risk feed would plausibly find them relevant; they are not the reader-harming junk that motivated ADR-023 (uplifting's false positives included a stranded sperm whale). Three of the six true positives lost at 4.25 are strong: oracle 5.85 (CoreWeave $56bn contracted revenue), 5.80 (climate vulnerability of Massachusetts substations), 5.55 (wildfires). The trade is 17 false positives for 6 true ones, which is why it shipped -- but if the lens owner disagrees, revert is one line in base_scorer.py plus a normalization refit.
